birth year: year the grid point was created
birth time: day the grid point was created [day]
number observations: number of observations of the grid point
x map: x map coordinate of the grid point [m]
y map: y map coordinate of the grid point [m]
x displacement: x displacement of the cell center [km]
y displacement: y displacement of the cell center [km]
cell area: cell area at the time of the observation [sq km]
difference area: change in cell area between observations [sq km]
dudx: du/dx ice motion partial of observation
dudy: du/dy ice motion partial of observation
dvdx: dv/dx ice motion partial of observation
dvdy: dv/dy ice motion partial of observation
